title: Spicy Vietnamese-Style Veggie Meatballs with Broccoli Slaw & Peanuts

steps.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Juice lime into a small bowl. Add soy sauce, chili-garlic sauce, sugar, and cornstarch; whisk to combine the sauce and set aside.
Peel and mince ginger and garlic; place both in a medium bowl.
Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the ginger and garlic.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Add veggie ground, bread crumbs, soy sauce, and spices to the bowl. Using your hands, mix well to combine.
Using a tablespoon measure, form the mixture into rounded "meatballs" and place on a plate.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add meatballs and cook, turning occasionally, until golden brown and cooked through, 6-8 minutes.
Meanwhile, trim and halve cucumber lengthwise, then cut crosswise into thin half-moons. Transfer to a clean plate.
Separate the lettuce into leaves and roughly chop or tear into bite-size pieces; add to the plate with the cucumber.
When the meatballs are done, add sauce to the skillet and turn to coat. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the sauce thickens slightly and coats meatballs, 3-4 minutes.
To serve, divide cucumbers, lettuce, and broccoli slaw between bowls. Top with saucy meatballs and sprinkle with peanuts. Enjoy!
